severityBasis: Functional continuity, integrity, privacy and implementation-planning priorities; not CVSS or validated vulnerability counts.
protectedInvariants: no CPU fallback for qualified CUDA motifs
historical memory never revives execution authority

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Unpinned combined launcher chooses 5173–5192. Fixed IDB/localStorage keys have no cross-origin migration. Port/hostname/Pages changes select different storage; Pages paths on one owner share a principal.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Stable canonical launch origin with explicit conflict/relocation policy plus verified data-only portability; explain same-origin cohost limits.
gaps.userImpact: Previously saved work appears absent at a new origin; current exports cannot move a full workspace.
gaps.securityImpact: Do not widen origins, scrape browser profiles or claim path-based isolation; no cross-origin exploit established.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Old data normally remains at old origin, but users can abandon it or create divergent copies.
gaps.implementationDependency: Choose stable-origin and migration contract before introducing durable workspace bytes.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Thread stores file/graph references and parser drafts; App graph/batches/bytes/history reset. No source/graph object store or complete workspace manifest exists.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Separate bounded content objects and verified project manifests; persist consented exact bytes/type/lineage and explicit missing-data states.
gaps.userImpact: A saved conversation does not resume the actual graph, mapping or uploaded dataset.
gaps.securityImpact: Current available:false/re-upload behavior is safe and must remain; no phantom graph restoration observed.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Unsaved graph/source transformations can be lost after frontend destruction; originals may still exist externally.
gaps.implementationDependency: 7A storage/CAS/schema contracts and existing typed graph normalization.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Mounted hook saves whole snapshots to shared main without project discriminator, revision CAS or cross-tab merge. Generic saveMessage is not used by the hook. Stale B snapshot overwrites A message in P05.
gaps.expectedBehavior: App/project namespace, revision CAS or deliberate single writer, safe conflict review and deletion tombstones; keep execution owner isolation.
gaps.userImpact: Two normal tabs/projects can silently lose contextual edits or mix intended workspaces.
gaps.securityImpact: Existing execution-owner separation is not chat/data isolation; no approval replay established.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Confirmed application snapshot overwrite semantics; real-browser concurrency qualification still required.
gaps.implementationDependency: Project identity and transactional revision contract, not timestamps alone.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Queue has one in-flight/one latest snapshot; disposal drops latest and suppresses callbacks without canceling issued write. UI generally says chat saved when ready and no error, without dirty/commit receipt.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Track dirty/enqueued/committed revision; acknowledge transaction completion; warn/export unsaved work; reject late stale-owner publication and deletion resurrection.
gaps.userImpact: Closing/reloading while writes stall can lose the newest visible state despite a reassuring status.
gaps.securityImpact: Late saves must not reintroduce deleted private data; current queue callback suppression alone is not storage cancellation.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Latest queued value is demonstrably dropped on controlled disposal; power-loss durability untested.
gaps.implementationDependency: Revision/CAS receipts and explicit lifecycle contract; no unconditional unload flush promise.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Thread load rejects unsupported schema/oversize/malformed shapes and hook becomes unavailable. No quarantine, read-only salvage/export, recovery retry or explicit abnormal-close flow exists.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Preserve unknown/corrupt original, bounded diagnosis/quarantine and last-good recovery; explicit forward-schema incompatibility and migration receipts.
gaps.userImpact: One damaged main record can disable persistence for the mount; user lacks a safe recovery path.
gaps.securityImpact: Current rejection is fail-closed, not an unsafe restore; future recovery must not execute or destructively normalize unknown fields.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Current bytes remain but may be inaccessible; improvised manual clearing can lose recoverable history.
gaps.implementationDependency: Typed supported-version policy and non-destructive legacy migration.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Thread is one projected object with synchronous JSON character checks, a render-time workspace stringify, silent truncation and key-order trim. Queue bounds writes but not total byte quota or recovery/backpressure UX.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Separate metadata/messages/content objects; byte/depth/count limits, chunking, quota headroom, visible retention/unsaved status and measured responsive backpressure.
gaps.userImpact: History is silently bounded; extending this record to datasets/graphs would create stalls/quota failures.
gaps.securityImpact: Persistent-record DoS requires an input/storage-write prerequisite; no remote exploit demonstrated.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Old messages/records can be trimmed; failed larger writes need an explicit authoritative-data policy.
gaps.implementationDependency: Measure budgets; keep execution/upload limits independent of persistence capacity.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Profile validation checks only id/name/parserCode. Unknown schema/fields and >60k code survive load; save caps 100 profiles, load/per-profile bytes are unbounded by app. Save can throw; legacy key persists; fingerprint is not cryptographic.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Typed bounded profile schema, supported migrations/quarantine, error receipts, explicit legacy cleanup and content digests for integrity/identity where required.
gaps.userImpact: Corrupt/large/foreign profiles or storage denial can impede profile workflows; old data can reappear if only the current key is removed.
gaps.securityImpact: Profiles remain inert until explicit Use and execution safety checks; no parser sandbox bypass established.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Corrupt load returns []; failed saves and incomplete legacy deletion have no coherent recovery receipt.
gaps.implementationDependency: Preserve existing parser review/sandbox/output limits and intentional reusable-profile semantics.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Settings load defaults on parse/access/migration-write failure; save catches errors silently and returns no acknowledgement. Unknown settings versions normalize to current; no total record cap.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Bounded typed configuration/migrations, distinguish load fallback from intentional reset, preserve incompatible originals, expose failed writes without claiming saved.
gaps.userImpact: Model preferences can silently disappear or fail to persist after restart.
gaps.securityImpact: Current startup remains disconnected; this is not proof a saved endpoint gains live authority. Actual request timeout/temperature clamps remain.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Preference changes may be lost; destructive future-version normalization must be avoided.
gaps.implementationDependency: Explicit configuration schema and migration/error receipt contract.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Only bounded messages and a 2000-char free-form summary persist. recentTurns and graph references reset; no typed objective/decision/task/completed-event/provenance model exists. Summary may not have run before close.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Application-owned project memory with objectives, reviewed decisions, verified events/result refs, unresolved tasks, source scope, timestamps and bounded selective prompts.
gaps.userImpact: Meaningful continuation depends on lossy text and differs between simple conversation and last-eight-message ReAct context.
gaps.securityImpact: LLM summaries must remain historical suggestions, never authoritative completed work or approvals.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Objectives/references can be forgotten through truncation, summarization and changed batch binding.
gaps.implementationDependency: 7B verified project/source/graph refs and deterministic event ownership.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Current prompts mark persistent context as context_only and prioritize live workspace, but durable text has no per-fact source/trust/verification/expiry/lineage fields for richer future memory/import.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Typed provenance/taint and project/data scope; model may propose facts, deterministic code accepts verified events; never launder a repeated assertion into authority.
gaps.userImpact: Historical claims can mislead explanations/proposals without an explicit factual lineage.
gaps.securityImpact: No current approval replay demonstrated; persistent prompt injection remains a threat requiring a real dispatcher-control failure for a vulnerability claim.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Incorrect inferred facts can replace useful context unless provenance/conflicts are retained.
gaps.implementationDependency: 7A schemas; 7B identities; current deterministic authorization/confirmation remains the authority.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Thread file references include id/name/size, not exact byte digest. Historical graph fingerprint lacks graph bytes and cannot validate a replacement dataset.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Exact source digest/byte count plus canonical graph type/schema/digest; distinguish renamed same bytes from same-name/same-size different bytes; revalidate mapping/parser applicability.
gaps.userImpact: References cannot reliably identify which externally retained file should resume a project.
gaps.securityImpact: Current re-upload does not automatically restore old authority; future digest-free rebinding would create integrity risk.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Wrong replacement can lose lineage or invalidate historical result meaning.
gaps.implementationDependency: Cryptographic source identities and typed canonicalization/versioning; names remain hints.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: App starts disconnected and explicit Connect automatically tries transports. No startup/idle reconnect lifecycle was found; idle prior Connected may remain until a request/probe detects loss. Interrupted generations are not resumed.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Separate preference/history from verified current liveness with timestamp/epoch; bounded explicit or consented reconnect policy; clear missing-model/service states and no replay.
gaps.userImpact: Every new session needs Connect; idle labels may be stale and interrupted work requires explicit retry.
gaps.securityImpact: Reprobe before live claims; do not introduce arbitrary endpoints, cloud fallback or silent model substitution.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Generation drafts/context can be interrupted; do not label partial output completed.
gaps.implementationDependency: 7A freshness schema/origin policy and current local-only request validation.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Bridge URL is build-environment-derived; an existing bundle does not discover a changed bridge port. Combined launcher updates bridge origins, but standard CANDY CLI still permits local :5173 only (plus one Pages origin).
gaps.expectedBehavior: Reviewed consistent origin/endpoint contract and explicit mismatch recovery across frontend, bridge and Runtime; exact origins and fresh service/schema/model checks.
gaps.userImpact: Fallback :5174 can connect Ollama yet fail CANDY discovery; bridge port changes can leave stale bundle targets.
gaps.securityImpact: No wildcard origin or health-only authorization; wrong local responder identity remains a conditional threat, not a validated exploit.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Connectivity can block resumed work; data remains in its original namespace.
gaps.implementationDependency: Stable origin decision and separately reviewed exact-origin companion configuration.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Current result registry is in-memory and session/application-bound. Runtime artifact metadata/jobs are RAM and recognized disk artifacts are purged on restart. No validated durable historical output format exists.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Separate immutable historical result object/manifest with exact input/update/output/provenance; never adopt old job/session/approval ids or reuse the purgeable artifact root as project storage.
gaps.userImpact: Completed analyses cannot be resumed as verified historical results after frontend/Runtime restart.
gaps.securityImpact: Current fail-closed session binding is correct; future archive/import must not revive Apply, native availability or current job authority.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Output not separately downloaded/saved is lost or intentionally cleaned up.
gaps.implementationDependency: 7A/7B verified objects; separate current-vs-historical evidence type and immutable backend provenance.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Clear chat and Forget saved workspace references have narrow asynchronous effects. Profiles/current+legacy keys/settings/pairing/exports/Runtime resources have separate lifecycles. Text/code can contain sensitive data; no app-wide erasure/retention receipt exists.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Explicit clear-chat/forget-refs/delete-project/clear-local-data scopes, all relevant keys and objects inventoried, durable tombstones/receipts, retention consent and export privacy; disclose external copies and physical erasure limits.
gaps.userImpact: Users lack a comprehensive project/privacy cleanup operation; narrow reference forgetting correctly does not erase everything.
gaps.securityImpact: Same-origin/profile access and shared exports can disclose content; no false claim that plaintext storage is encrypted or that a narrow button promised full erasure.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Overbroad improvised deletion can destroy wanted work; incomplete deletion can retain unwanted copies.
gaps.implementationDependency: Owned object registry/tombstones, consent and clear limits for legacy stores/downloads/host backups.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Browser-managed thread/settings/profile storage has no full workspace backup/import layer or persistent-storage/eviction contract. Profile JSON and selected data downloads are partial exports only.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Verified bounded data-only workspace export/import, storage durability/eviction disclosure, backup freshness and conflict/migration review. Browser persistence is not a guaranteed backup.
gaps.userImpact: Changing machine/origin or clearing/evicting site storage cannot recover an entire project with current tooling.
gaps.securityImpact: Workspace imports require schema/path/expansion bounds and must exclude authority/credentials/native installation trust.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Site-data deletion/eviction can permanently lose contextual work without external copies.
gaps.implementationDependency: 7A namespaces/migration and 7B source/result object manifest; source-package security contract preserved.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: Visualization/layout/selection/algorithm stepping/export-preview state is in local React/refs and resets; no durable preference chain exists.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Optionally restore compatible non-authoritative preferences and validate selected ids against actual current graph; recompute previews/caches and discard stale handles.
gaps.userImpact: Users repeat view/setup choices after returning.
gaps.securityImpact: Saved selections/export handles must not become actions or facts about an absent graph.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Low: presentational state lost, not authoritative source bytes.
gaps.implementationDependency: 7B validated graph identity and namespaced settings; no need to persist derived caches.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: activeTransport/activeBaseUrl persist inside model configuration without observedAt/freshness. App status safely starts disconnected, but diagnostics can retain endpoint observations.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Separate reusable settings, lastKnownConnection history and ephemeral verified connection generation; label old observations explicitly.
gaps.userImpact: Remembered endpoint/transport can be mistaken for live status in future UI changes.
gaps.securityImpact: Current ordinary startup does not trust them as Connected; preserve that counterevidence.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Low: misleading interpretation rather than present authoritative data loss.
gaps.implementationDependency: 7A configuration schema and 7D fresh connection-state owner.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.currentBehavior: UI download is named parser-profiles-v7-2.json while export schema is hypergraph-parser-profiles-v7.3 and current records use schemaVersion 3.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Version/schema-consistent naming and explicit compatibility information, without blanket rewriting historical references.
gaps.userImpact: Export compatibility/version is harder to understand.
gaps.securityImpact: No execution or authorization bypass demonstrated.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Low: potential import confusion; bytes remain available.
gaps.implementationDependency: Qualified profile format/migration contract; distinguish format version from product release version.

gaps.classification: Scope 7 readiness gap; not a validated security vulnerability
gaps.subsystem: Physical restart and persistence qualification coverage
gaps.currentBehavior: Existing mounted reload/storage tests use an IDB double/happy-dom; they do not qualify real browser crash, Windows restart, effective ACLs, quota/eviction or full multi-session workspace storage.
gaps.expectedBehavior: Separate mocked/source, real-browser, actual service/native and physical restart evidence with exact-SHA fixtures and explicit coverage; test every failure boundary.
gaps.userImpact: Without new evidence, future durable-resume promises could exceed tested behavior.
gaps.securityImpact: Do not infer Windows ACL privacy, power-loss safety or native authority validity from source/fixture passes.
gaps.dataLossRisk: Unmeasured until implemented and fault-qualified; not a new failure of frozen Scope 6E release qualification.
gaps.implementationDependency: Implemented contracts and explicit authorization/window for physical reboot and genuine local-backend qualification.
